+++ b/src/billing/round.ts
@@ -12,7 +12,9 @@ export function roundHalfEven(value: number, places = 2): number {
-  return Math.round(value * 100) / 100
+  const factor = 10 ** places
+  const n = value * factor
+  return (Math.abs(n % 1) === 0.5 ? 2 * Math.round(n / 2) : Math.round(n)) / factor
